BiblicalUsage: ekplḗrōsis is the word for accomplishment. In Acts 21:26, the text says "to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification."
TheologicalSignificance: In ekplḗrōsis I find no hidden theology; it simply means accomplishment.
RelatedEvents: Paul Purifies Himself at the Temple
